newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mostly up, corn, SRW wheat down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mostly up, corn, SRW wheat down.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values were higher on Friday while corn and soft white wheat values dropped.
"We don't have a lot of wheat for exports" but on the other hand stocks are tight, one dealer said. So one is pulling against the other, he added.
Another dealer noted there appeared to be not enough nearby soybean supplies for the export pipeline while corn supplies were adequate.
In export news, The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought two shipments totalling 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
And Philippine flour mills bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Japanese trading firm Mitsubishi Corp, traders said.
